title: rorippa terrestris
intro: Rorippa terrestris, commonly known as Land Cress, is a type of edible herb that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is rich in nutrients and has been used for its medicinal and culinary properties. The health benefits of Rorippa terrestris include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function, due to its high content of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. The bioactive constituents of Land Cress include glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
